description: Анализ метрик синхронизации: avg, min, max, RMS по master и slave узлам

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname AS metric,
  avg(offset_ns) AS "Offset (ns)"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${phc2sys_node_type}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  n.hostname,
  n.type::text AS type,
  round(avg(abs(offset_ns))) AS "Avg",
  min(offset_ns) AS "Min",
  max(offset_ns) AS "Max",
  round(sqrt(avg(power(offset_ns::float8, 2)))) AS "RMS"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY n.hostname, n.type
ORDER BY n.type, n.hostname

-- Кривые нод
SELECT
    n.hostname              AS hostname,
    m.window_size::numeric  AS window_size,
    m.mtie_ns               AS ns
FROM timesync.phc2sys_quality_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE (m.node_id, m.time) IN (
SELECT node_id, MAX(time)
FROM timesync.phc2sys_quality_metrics
GROUP BY node_id
)
UNION ALL

WITH last_before AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.hostname, e.port)
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time,
    n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
    e.to_state
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
  JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
  WHERE e.time < $__timeFrom()
    AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
    AND e.port > 0
  ORDER BY n.hostname, e.port, e.time DESC
)
SELECT
  e.time,
  n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
  e.to_state
FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time)
  AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
  AND e.port > 0

UNION ALL

SELECT time, series, to_state FROM last_before

ORDER BY time, series

SELECT

WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time)

ORDER BY e.time DESC
LIMIT 200

WITH ptp AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  ptp.t AS time,
  n.hostname AS metric,
  ptp.offset - pps.offset AS "ptp4l - PPS (ns)"
FROM ptp
JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = ptp.node_id AND pps.t = ptp.t
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = ptp.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${ptp4l_node_type}'
ORDER BY 1

WITH ptp AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
diff AS (
  SELECT ptp.node_id, ptp.offset - pps.offset AS delta
  FROM ptp JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = ptp.node_id AND pps.t = ptp.t
)
SELECT
  n.hostname,
  n.type::text AS type,
  round(avg(abs(delta))) AS "Avg abs",
  min(delta) AS "Min",
  max(delta) AS "Max",
  round(sqrt(avg(power(delta::float8, 2)))) AS "RMS"
FROM diff
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = diff.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY n.hostname, n.type
ORDER BY n.type, n.hostname
